name: waking up
description: The sense that you had been physically asleep, that time has passed without you being aware of the world.
results: Maybe you'll want to go back to sleep, maybe you'll feel refreshed, or maybe you'll want a cup of caffeine.

commentaries.quote: This entry is about waking up from physical sleep. This phrase is also commonly used in a metaphoric way to mean 'social realization', 'epiphany', or 'woke'.
Waking up this morning, I smile. 24 brand new hours are before me. I vow to live fully in each moment.
Every morning I wake up and thank God.
I arise in the morning torn between a desire to improve the world and a desire to enjoy the world.

You’ve got to wake up each day and understand what that day is about; you’ve got to have personal goals. Be flexible in getting to those goals, but if you do not have goals, you will not achieve them.
